source.historical_scenario_source: run_fail_hd.py BASE and G0/G7 scenario settings; core_hd.simulate_hd/build_X/cf_X

frozen_engine.role: Byte-identical copy of the fixed-design fit, covariance, calibration, interval and summary helpers; primary fixed_design.py remains unchanged.

design.counterfactual: Use Hcf from core_hd.simulate_hd with cfg.bias=0 for both estimator and truth; this fixes the H/Hcf exposure paths for each scenario design and avoids the estimated-counterfactual truth mutation when cfg.bias is nonzero. core_hd.common_bias changes eta0 for both factual and counterfactual means and may therefore change scenario-specific A_true.
design.truth: For each scenario-specific fixed design, A_true=sum(mu-mucf) over all regions and months. The same scenario-specific truth is reused for every outcome resample within that design; it need not be equal across scenarios.

scenarios.name: model_compatible
scenarios.description: Project log(source mu/pop) on the two-lag heat-day design with fixed knots [0,3,8], then regenerate factual and counterfactual means exactly from the projected beta.

scenarios.name: source_h_quadratic
scenarios.description: Use the pinned heat-day source DGP g(H)=0.020H+0.0010H^2 with lag weights (0.6,0.4), without added common bias.

scenarios.name: common_bias_0_12
scenarios.description: Use the pinned heat-day quadratic DGP and core_hd.common_bias=0.12. The common bias changes eta0 for factual and counterfactual means, so A_true may differ from the zero-common-bias scenario; cfg.bias=0 keeps the H/Hcf exposure paths fixed.

sampling.rep_seed_rule: NumPy SeedSequence([base_seed, mode_id, scenario_id, design_seed, stage_id, replicate_index])
sampling.finite_sample_quantile: k=ceil((n_cal+1)*(1-alpha)); return sorted_scores[k-1] when k<=n_cal and +infinity when k>n_cal.

methods.delta_primary: Component-specific two-way CR1 using grouped region×year intersection meat; raw covariance is not clipped.
methods.delta_corrected_common_cr1_tw: Correct grouped intersection meat with the legacy common min-cluster correction and the same PSD clipping policy, to isolate the intersection aggregation change.
methods.delta_legacy_covariance: Pinned-source observation-level intersection subtraction with common min-cluster correction and PSD clipping.
methods.independent_scale_calibrated: Independent calibration outcomes estimate the finite-sample quantile of absolute error divided by corrected standard error.
methods.truth_trained_bias_centered_split_calibr: Known-truth simulation diagnostic using disjoint bias-training, scale-calibration and test outcomes.
methods.year_half_split_q_diagnostic: 30 random 5-of-10 year splits on the first two pilot / first 25 formal test outcomes; all coefficients are fit in each half and predictions/gradients use the full fixed grid. Diagnostic only, not an independent conformal guarantee.
methods.estimator_only_common_bias: Add the fixed common shift to estimates in all outcome stages while keeping A_true unchanged; truth-trained centering must restore the same q algebraically.

fit.method_validity: Coefficient fit requires convergence, full rank and finite coefficients/estimate. Each method interval additionally requires its own positive finite variance.
fit.failed_interval_policy: Count planned replicate as uncovered; retain fit and variance diagnostics; summarize valid infinite widths as infinite.
